samples.question: Panel A is the left panel and panel B is the right panel. Each panel is a heatmap with four labeled rows and six equal-width columns, using one shared blue-to-yellow scale. For each panel, horizontal contrast is the mean absolute heat difference between neighboring columns, averaged over all rows. Which panel has the greater horizontal contrast? Choose A or B; ties and near ties are quarantined.
